about: A project memory note says where release notes go and their format; the repo has no release notes, so only memory can tell.

memory.name: Release notes
memory.description: Where release notes go and their format
memory.body: Release notes live in docs/releases/<version>.md (for example docs/releases/2.3.0.md). Each file starts with a `# v<version>` heading, then one `- ` line per user-visible change.

prompt: Write the release notes for version 2.4.0. There's one change: the new /codemode command, which turns code mode on or off for new threads. Put them where this project keeps its release notes.
